text:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up: client Speedline reported a latency regression after yesterday's model rollout (3.2). p50 ~130ms -> 240ms, p95 jumping to ~1.1s. Renewals team flagged a pre-QBR demo next week. We should propose a low-friction mitigation.
aj_dev: Ugh. Do we know the request mix? short messages vs long summarize calls?
maria_cs: Mostly short conversational queries (~25-40 tokens) but theres a spike of nightly bulk summarize jobs that grow KV cache size.
olivia_sre: Two-step plan that worked elsewhere: 1) route short requests to compact-int8 variant to cut token CPU; 2) deploy a prefix KV cache for the nightly workflows. Start with a small canary for the routing change.
aj_dev: I can add a routing policy. Suggest rules like:
```
- match: { tokens: { lt: 64 } }
  route: speedline-compact-int8
  weight: 0.15
- match: { tokens: { gte: 64 } }
  route: speedline-3.2
  weight: 1.0
```
We'll tune weight after 12h windows.
li_eng: compact-int8 bench: ~40-50% cost reduction on token compute, minor drop in long-form coherence. Strongly recommend an eval set of ~60 long prompts (the nightly ones) and a short eval of 100 conversational prompts. I'll prepare harness.
sam_re: Renewal risk: client mentioned latency as a sticking point for expansion. If we can show p95 improvements and cost delta in the QBR, that helps retention. I'll prep a short slide with before/after numbers.
ops-bot: :gear: Canary rollout scheduled: speedline-compact-int8 -> 10% traffic for 48h. Monitoring hooks enabled.
maria_cs: Thanks. I'll book a 30-min enablement/demo with the customer for Tues 10am PT and capture their live feedback.
olivia_sre: Canary monitors: p50/p95, error rate, token cost, and a small QoE metric against the eval set. Auto-rollback: error rate +5% OR QoE drop >10% on eval.
aj_dev: I'll add a dashboard tile for the routing split + cost delta and post the route YAML to this thread.
li_eng: Eval harness draft: https://redwood.internal/eval/speedline-compact-int8-60 (internal only). Please add any customer prompts you want included.
maria_cs: Checklist: canary live (olivia), eval ready (li), dashboard (aj), demo booked (maria), renewal slide draft (sam). I'll collect post-demo notes and run the 2-question satisfaction pulse.
sam_re: If metrics look good after 24h, I'll flag renewal owner to adjust talking points.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Canary at 10% live. Alerts on-call if thresholds breach.
maria_cs: Great work team. Keep updates in this thread and paste the final before/after chart for the renewal deck.
aj_dev: Will follow up with exact YAML + cost estimate (projected 42% token compute savings at 70% short-request mix).
li_eng: Will add coherence and factuality labels for the long eval set and share results within 48h.
olivia_sre: Monitoring looks clean so far. Pinged #eng-oncall if anything pops.
maria_cs: Closing loop for now  will post customer feedback after the demo. :thumbsup:
